environment.description: Same EKS pod deployed in namespace 'media-processing-prod'. Service is ClusterIP (not externally exposed). Ingress is handled by an AWS ALB Ingress Controller with annotation alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal. A Cilium NetworkPolicy with spec.ingress[0].fromEndpoints matching only labels app=api-gateway restricts pod-to-pod traffic on port 8080. Additionally, the ALB target group health check path is /health and no listener rule forwards to /debug/*. The CloudFront distribution has Origin Access Control (OAC) configured with signing protocol sigv4, and the origin (S3) bucket policy denies all requests lacking the x-amz-content-sha256 header set by CloudFront OAC. The pod's ServiceAccount has an IAM Role with a permission boundary that denies secretsmanager:GetSecretValue for any principal outside the VPC endpoint policy. Istio AuthorizationPolicy requires JWT with issuer 'https://auth.internal.corp' and audience 'media-signer' for any path matching '/debug/*'.

config.cilium_network_policy: ingress restricted to app=api-gateway label only
config.cloudfront_oac: sigv4 signing, origin bucket denies unsigned requests
config.iam_permission_boundary: denies secrets access outside VPC endpoint
